title: UI Profile
description: Declarative editing form for one Linked Art record class (spec section 6.1). One YAML file per class in profiles/ui/, named <class>.yaml. See profiles/README.md for the path syntax and the per-widget path contract.

class.description: The Linked Art record class this profile edits. Must equal the file name stem.

version.description: Profile version. Increment when slots are added, removed, or re-pathed.

sections.description: Ordered form sections. Section ids are unique within the profile.

grid_columns.description: Optional ordered column list for the grid view. When absent, the grid uses every non-advanced slot in form order.

advanced.description: When true the whole section is collapsed behind 'Add details'. Defaults to false.

Slot.description: One editable field bound to a path. Slot ids are unique across the whole profile.

value_set.description: Value Set governing the Type references this slot edits (see profiles/README.md). Must exist in profiles/vocab/ once any Value Set is defined.

allowed_classes.description: Record classes a reference in this slot may point at. Drives autocomplete types and drag-and-drop targeting. Required for entity_ref slots, not allowed on other widgets.

multiple.description: The slot holds an ordered collection of entries rather than at most one.

required.description: UI hint: the form marks the slot as required and flags it while empty. Publish-blocking rules live in SHACL shapes, not here.

advanced.description: The slot is hidden behind 'Add details' even inside a non-advanced section.

slot.description: Id of a slot in this profile.

label.description: Column header. Defaults to the slot label.

LangMap.description: Human-readable string keyed by BCP-47 language tag in canonical case (language lower, Script title, REGION upper). 'en' is required. Values must contain a non-space character.

Path.description: Profile path: dot-separated Linked Art JSON-LD keys, each optionally filtered by class, e.g. identified_by[Name] or produced_by.timespan. Grammar in profiles/README.md.

RecordClass.description: A top-level Linked Art record class (linked.art docs/ns/v1/record-types.json).
